## [1.1.1](https://github.com/WaggBR/Wagg13Patch_Morphe/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) (2026-10-05)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* remove hardcoded version from patches build ([ab4fc41](https://github.com/WaggBR/Wagg13Patch_Morphe/commit/ab4fc41d1db0bbc9dc00108b0ace55f0e9b093bf))

patches.name: Hide live room notice
patches.description: Removes the 'healthy live streaming' notice shown in every live chat.

patches.name: Unlock SVIP
patches.description: Unlocks SVIP features, blocks purchase flow and Unity Ads.

patches.name: Story mention indicator
patches.description: Shows an "@N mention" pill in the story header when the story mentions someone. Tap it to list and open the mentioned profiles.

patches.name: Instants Mod
patches.description: Support for posting photos from the gallery to Instants via the gallery icon on the home screen.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Forces the Premium state source before it is recalculated and adds the mod author signature below the Bisbi version.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is stored locally and controls features such as the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. Compatible with v1.4 and v1.4.1 (PairIP was removed in v1.4.1).

patches.name: Tinder Remove Ads
patches.description: Remove os anúncios exibidos entre os perfis do deck de swipe.

patches.name: Tinder Unlimited Rewind
patches.description: Bypasses the paywall check and enables unlimited REWIND on FREE accounts.
